Berit Holzgartner Honored with the Prestigious Günter-Schwank Award

Berit Holzgartner mit Stiftern und Sprechern der Günter-Schwank-Preisverleihung in Frankfurt am Main.
Berit Holzgartner bei der Übergabe des Günter-Schwank-Preises im Rahmen der feierlichen Preisverleihung.

Share this news

Frankfurt am Main, Germany – In a formal ceremony, our colleague Berit Holzgartner from Gerresheimer Regensburg GmbH was awarded the Günter-Schwank Prize by the Gesamtverband Kunststoffverarbeitende Industrie (GKV, German Association of the Plastics Processing Industry). This prestigious award is presented annually to the top ten young professionals nationwide in the field of plastics and rubber technology.

The award ceremony took place in front of approximately 100 guests at the House of Chemistry (VCI) in Frankfurt am Main, providing a platform for emerging young talents to be celebrated for their exceptional achievements. The award highlighted the importance of well-trained professionals at a time when industry and technology are constantly evolving.

We are delighted that Berit will continue to contribute to our company following her successful completion of a dual study program in plastics engineering and her in-house training. We extend our sincere congratulations to her and the entire training team at Gerresheimer Regensburg GmbH.
